subject: science

sections.scope_note: Arizona standards deferred. This crosswalk covers Florida NGSSS Science (2016) and IB PYP only. Rows are suggested (Label C).

ib_framework_elements: PYP transdisciplinary theme: How the world works
rows.key_differences: Florida's six benchmarks specify team exploration, comparing observations, repeating investigations, and separating observation from inference. Public PYP text describes inquiry without those six sentences.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Run a short team observation, record what was seen, and ask 'how do you know?' before offering an idea.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Materials and matter (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP concept: Form (name reused from grade 3)
PYP concept: Change (name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida lists properties, solid/liquid/gas, water's states, daily temperature, liquid volume, and materials that do not all change the same way. The strand name is reused, not a grade 2 IB outcome.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Sort materials in the inquiry by state and one property, then try one change and note what did not change.

rows.topic_domain: Pushes, pulls, magnets, and everyday energy
ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Forces and energy (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP transdisciplinary theme: How the world works
rows.key_differences: Florida includes magnets moving objects without touch, objects pulled toward the ground, and people using energy to cook, heat or cool homes, and power cars. Public theme text does not list those examples.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Test a push, a pull, and a magnet, then name one way people use energy at home.

rows.topic_domain: Living things - body, life cycles, needs, habitats
ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Living things (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP transdisciplinary theme: Sharing the planet
rows.key_differences: Florida names body parts, beans and butterflies, basic needs, and habitats. Sharing the planet is a public theme; the examples are Florida's.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Observe one plant or animal life stage and state the needs its habitat has to meet.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Earth and space (strand name reused from grade 3)
PYP concept: Change (name reused from grade 3)
rows.key_differences: Florida covers rocks, soil, repeating weather, the Sun warming water, land, and air, evaporation from an open container, wind, and preparing for severe weather. The public pages do not list those investigations.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Track weather for several days and connect one change (heat, wind, or water disappearing) to an observation.
